user.title: Connect to Eplucon
user.description: Please enter your API token to connect to Eplucon ({api_tokens_url}).

data_description.scan_interval: How often the Eplucon portal is polled. A longer interval sends fewer requests to the portal.

developer_options.name: Developer tools
developer_options.description: Only needed when working on this integration.

data_description.use_mock_data: Read every value from the mock files bundled with the integration instead of the Eplucon API. No request is sent and the API token is ignored.

zone_control.name: Room temperature control (optional)
zone_control.description: Reading sensors only needs the API token. To change a room setpoint, enter the Eplucon portal login. This uses an undocumented portal route and may stop working if Eplucon changes its website.

data_description.portal_username: Usually the email address used to sign in to the Eplucon portal.
data_description.portal_password: Stored in this Home Assistant config entry. Leave blank in options to keep the saved password.
data_description.remove_portal_credentials: Remove the saved username and password and disable climate controls.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Please check your API token and/or API endpoint.
error.api: Failed to connect to the Eplucon API. Please check the API endpoint and try again or check the logs for more info.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or check the logs for more info.
error.no-devices: No devices found. Ensure you're device is added to your Eplucon account
error.zone-credentials: Enter both the Eplucon portal username and password, or leave both empty.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Eplucon is allowed.
